title: 美股AI硬件重挫压制A/H科技，储能规划与盘后订单仅提供条件线索
summary: 纳指跌5.52%、半导体指数跌逾12%，电子元件、半导体设备、电气零件和计算机硬件行业均跌逾10%；北京储能规划、全面节约行动以及宏盛华源和天赐材料盘后公告提供局部事件线索，但今日需先验证A/H开盘价格反馈。

关键词云图

利好利空中性w1-w5表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美股AI与半导体链遭遇19个月最深单日下跌
11月5日美股收盘，纳指跌5.52%、标普500跌4.36%、道指跌3.44%；英伟达跌逾9%，费城半导体指数跌逾12%，成交量显著放大。AI基础设施监管担忧与加息信号共同压制风险偏好。来源：Reuters。
排行
广告领涨、硬件与半导体领跌，板块分化极端
11月5日现金时段，广告代理+18.99%，APP +31.04%；固态电池概念+8.81%，TM +9.35%。相反，电子元件-10.37%、半导体-11.46%、半导体设备-12.33%、电气设备-12.53%、计算机硬件-14.94%。来源：GitHub Actions/Moomoo 08:33 CST快照。
夜盘
ETF代理延续弱势，未出现明确盘后反转
运行时公开报价约08:20 CST：QQQ 647.05美元、较前收-6.33%；SPY 733.00美元、-4.35%；DIA 514.27美元、-3.50%。三者是延长时段代理，涨跌为相对前收的累计变化，来源未拆分收盘后单独增量。
政策
北京新型能源体系规划明确储能与电网技术方向
规划提出推动固态、液流等电池技术研发，发展系统集成与高端制造，到2030年新型储能装机达到60万千瓦；同时推进智能电网、电力芯片和“人工智能+能源”。方向明确，但地方规划不等于公司订单。来源：北京市政府规划原文。
政策
全面节约战略把算力节能、节水与循环利用纳入硬目标
国家发展改革委等五部门要求推进算力、通信基站和机房节能降碳改造，并强化农业节水、工业水效和动力电池全生命周期管理。到2030年单位GDP能耗和用水量均较2025年下降约10%。来源：国家发展改革委通知、方案原文。
科技
晶合集成四期晶圆产线获大额增资与回购安排
晶合集成拟与合肥建投、合肥勤合向晶奕集成合计增资91亿元，公司出资51亿元并继续控股；项目建设12英寸晶圆产线，规划产能约5.5万片/月。同时公司拟回购5亿至8亿元股份。资本开支、良率和需求兑现仍需跟踪。来源：财联社公告汇总、巨潮资讯公告检索。
公告
宏盛华源中标约7.25亿元国家电网项目
子公司在输变电及特高压材料招标中中标26个标包，金额约7.25亿元，占2025年经审计营收7.57%；正式合同尚未签署。11月5日收盘3.79元、涨0.80%，价格早于盘后公告。来源：公告转录、收盘行情。
公告
大禹节水联合体中标21.44亿元灌区项目
安庆下浒山水库灌区项目采用“股权投资+EPCO”，但公司承担的建设和运营份额约9.77%，项目合作期长达40年，不能把联合体总金额直接视为公司收入。11月5日收盘3.34元、涨2.14%。来源：公告转录、收盘行情。
公告
金刚光伏云计算合同上限15.36亿元，但股价已先涨停
控股子公司签署算力云服务合同，含税预估总价不超过15.36亿元，首两批合计约3.84亿元；交易对手未完整披露，最终收入取决于交付量和价格。11月5日收盘18.66元、涨20%，公告前已充分交易。来源：公司公告转录、收盘行情。
公告
天赐材料签订45万吨电解液长期供货协议
子公司拟于2027至2029年向亿纬锂能供应合计45万吨电解液，实际采购量和价格以订单为准。11月5日收盘29.01元、涨5.45%，同样早于盘后公告；该液态电解液协议不能直接等同于固态电池受益。来源：公告索引、收盘行情。
港股
港股前一日科技修复与隔夜美股暴跌形成时点冲突
AKShare 11月5日14:48盘中快照显示恒生科技+5.32%，港股上涨1519家、下跌845家、平盘783家；但该数据早于随后美股AI硬件抛售，不能据此推断今日恒科仍强。港交所公告与停复牌清单已核对，未发现足以覆盖隔夜风险的已核实重大利好。
商品
油价急跌后反弹，但高波动仍压制风险偏好
Brent在前一日大跌后盘中反弹约2.5%至96.8美元附近。能源成本回升可能重新推高通胀与利率担忧，运输和下游成本改善逻辑也随之减弱。来源：Reuters全球市场报道；价格为报道时点，并非本轮实时结算价。

美股夜盘行情总结

指数
风险资产进入急速去杠杆
纳指-5.52%、标普500 -4.36%、道指-3.44%；运行时QQQ、SPY、DIA代理仍为-6.33%、-4.35%、-3.50%，没有可验证的盘后反转。
板块
广告独强，硬件与半导体成为风险核心
APP +31.04%确认广告代理强势；但电子元件、半导体、设备、电气零件和计算机硬件均下跌10%以上。弱势行业代表股多数逆势上涨，说明行业跌幅并非由单一龙头驱动，广度压力更值得重视。
A/H映射
A/H科技先防守，固态电池只做事件级观察
11月5日A股中位涨1.87%、恒科盘中涨5.32%，均早于美股抛售；今日不能沿用旧强势。天赐材料与固态电池概念只构成条件观察，睿创微纳和公告前涨停的金刚光伏继续回避。

盘前结论

政策端仍有结构支撑：北京规划明确新型储能、智能电网与电力芯片方向，全面节约行动强化算力节能、节水和循环利用。

隔夜美股出现广度化科技抛售，半导体与硬件行业跌幅均超过10%；11月5日A/H盘中强势数据已过时，今日先按风险降档处理。

宏盛华源、天赐材料仅列条件关注；金刚光伏因公告前涨停与兑现不确定性回避，睿创微纳因明确负价格反馈回避。不强行凑多头推荐。

重点个股关注

宏盛华源
601096.SH
条件关注

事实与状态：盘后披露约7.25亿元国家电网中标，占2025年营收7.57%；11月5日收盘3.79元、涨0.80%，尚未反映公告。

确认条件：正式合同签署，开盘后守住3.79元并持续强于输变电设备同业。

风险与失效：合同未签、交付与毛利率未知；若高开低走并跌回3.79元下方，观察逻辑失效。

天赐材料
002709.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：拟于2027至2029年向亿纬锂能供应45万吨电解液；11月5日收盘29.01元、涨5.45%，价格早于盘后公告。

确认条件：开盘后守住29.01元，订单量价和排产得到进一步确认，且相对锂电材料板块保持强势。

风险与失效：协议量价以实际订单为准，液态电解液不等于固态电池直接受益；跌回前收下方或明显弱于板块即降级。

金刚光伏
300093.SZ
回避

事实与状态：云服务合同上限15.36亿元，但交易对手未完整披露；股价在公告前已收于18.66元并20%涨停。

重新评估条件：客户、交付、回款与利润贡献被持续验证，且公告后价格能在充分换手后稳定。

风险与失效：公告前抢跑、上限金额不等于收入，叠加隔夜计算机硬件-14.94%与电气设备-12.53%，不追高。

睿创微纳
688002.SH
回避

事实与状态：11月5日收盘129.40元、跌15.42%，与隔夜半导体行业-11.46%、半导体设备-12.33%的全球负反馈共振。

重新评估条件：先出现止跌、放量承接并持续跑赢科创50和半导体同业，再评估基本面催化。

风险与失效：AI硬件去杠杆与监管担忧仍在，弱势价格反馈不得包装成多头机会。来源：收盘行情。

板块轮动看板

相对强势广告科技、固态电池主题；前者有APP价格确认，后者需区分固态与液态电解液
条件观察输变电中标与节能、节水项目；必须等合同、量价和开盘相对强度
压力方向半导体、设备、电子元件、电气零件与计算机硬件
验证信号恒科与科创50能否抵抗隔夜冲击；宏盛华源守3.79元、天赐材料守29.01元

逻辑链

美股AI监管担忧 + 加息信号 → 纳指与半导体急跌 → A/H科技开盘风险溢价上升。
广告代理+18.99%而硬件行业跌逾10% → 资金从资本开支链向现金流更清晰的应用侧切换 → A/H只做公司级映射。
北京储能规划 + 固态电池概念+8.81% → 锂电关注度提升 → 天赐材料因协议量价未定仅作条件观察。
宏盛华源中标占营收7.57% → 订单催化清晰但合同未签 → 等开盘价格与正式合同双确认。
金刚光伏公告前涨停 + 硬件/电气行业暴跌 → 追高赔率恶化 → 维持回避。

风险雷达

隔夜传导美股半导体与硬件跌幅超过10%，A/H开盘可能先补跌。
公告兑现中标、框架和上限金额均不等于已确认收入，正式合同、量价和回款仍是关键。
时点错配AKShare为11月5日14:48盘中快照，早于隔夜美股抛售，不能作为今日开盘确认。
报价口径ETF代理是相对前收累计变化，未拆分收盘后单独增量。

数据来源与时间点

研究与报价截止2026-11-06 08:40 CST。美股指数和板块为11月5日现金时段；ETF代理约08:20 CST；AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt 2026-11-05 14:48:03 CST，为11月5日盘中快照。主要来源：Reuters、北京市政府、国家发展改革委、巨潮资讯/交易所公告检索、GitHub Actions/Moomoo及公开延迟行情。盘前报道与公告速递仅用于发现，重大项目已用公司公告索引或独立行情源交叉核对；港交所无法取得完整数字的个案未写入结论。

Keyword Cloud

AI hardware rout Hardware leads losses Advertising surge Solid-state battery Beijing storage plan Computing efficiency Grid tenders Electrolyte agreement Pre-filing limit-up Negative feedback Data timestamp Proxy methodology
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates importance, not performance.
Major News
Global
AI and chip rout delivers Nasdaq’s steepest daily fall in 19 months
On November 5, the Nasdaq fell 5.52%, the S&P 500 4.36% and the Dow 3.44%. Nvidia lost more than 9% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index more than 12% on heavy volume. AI-infrastructure regulation concerns and renewed rate-hike signals hit risk appetite. Source: Reuters.
Ranking
Advertising leads while hardware and semiconductors collapse
For the November 5 cash session, Advertising Agencies rose 18.99% with APP +31.04%, while Solid State Battery gained 8.81% with TM +9.35%. Electronic Components fell 10.37%, Semiconductors 11.46%, Semiconductor Equipment 12.33%, Electrical Equipment 12.53% and Computer Hardware 14.94%. Source: GitHub Actions/Moomoo snapshot at 08:33 CST.
Overnight
ETF proxies remain weak with no clear after-hours reversal
Public quotes around 08:20 CST showed QQQ at $647.05 (-6.33% versus the prior close), SPY at $733.00 (-4.35%) and DIA at $514.27 (-3.50%). These are extended-hours proxies; the changes are cumulative versus the prior close and do not isolate the post-close move.
Policy
Beijing energy plan targets storage and smart-grid technologies
The plan calls for R&D in solid-state and flow batteries, system integration and high-end manufacturing, with 600 MW of new energy storage by 2030. It also promotes smart grids, power chips and “AI + Energy.” A local plan is directionally supportive but is not a company order. Source: Beijing government plan.
Policy
National conservation plan adds hard targets for computing efficiency and water use
Five agencies call for energy-efficiency upgrades in computing facilities, base stations and server rooms, together with agricultural water saving, industrial water efficiency and battery lifecycle management. By 2030, energy and water use per unit of GDP should each fall about 10% from 2025. Source: NDRC notice and full plan.
Technology
Nexchip unit receives RMB91bn capital injection and a buyback plan
Nexchip and two Hefei state-backed investors plan to inject RMB91bn into Jingyi Integrated; Nexchip contributes RMB51bn and retains control. The project is building a 12-inch wafer fab with planned capacity of about 55,000 wafers per month. Nexchip also announced a RMB500m–800m buyback. Capex, yield and demand execution remain key risks. Sources: CLS announcement digest and CNINFO filings.
Filing
Hongsheng Huayuan wins about RMB725m of State Grid tenders
Subsidiaries won 26 transmission and UHV-material packages worth about RMB725m, equal to 7.57% of audited 2025 revenue. Formal contracts have not been signed. The stock closed November 5 at RMB3.79, up 0.80%, before the after-close filing. Sources: filing transcript and closing quote.
Filing
Dayu consortium wins RMB2.144bn irrigation project
The Anqing Xiazhushan reservoir irrigation project uses an “equity investment + EPCO” structure, but Dayu’s construction and operating share is about 9.77% and the cooperation period is 40 years. The consortium value cannot be treated as Dayu revenue. The stock closed at RMB3.34, up 2.14%. Sources: filing transcript and closing quote.
Filing
Jingang Solar signs cloud-computing contract capped at RMB1.536bn after a limit-up move
A controlled unit signed a cloud-service contract with an estimated tax-inclusive ceiling of RMB1.536bn; the first two batches total about RMB384m. The counterparty is not fully disclosed and realized revenue depends on delivery and pricing. The stock had already closed limit-up at RMB18.66 before the filing. Sources: filing transcript and closing quote.
Filing
Tinci signs a 450,000-tonne electrolyte supply agreement
A subsidiary plans to supply EVE Energy with a total of 450,000 tonnes of electrolyte from 2027 to 2029; actual volumes and prices depend on orders. The stock closed at RMB29.01, up 5.45%, before the filing. This liquid-electrolyte agreement is not direct proof of solid-state-battery exposure. Sources: filing index and closing quote.
Hong Kong
Prior HSTECH rebound conflicts with the later US technology rout
The November 5 14:48 CST AKShare snapshot showed HSTECH +5.32% with 1,519 advancers, 845 decliners and 783 unchanged in Hong Kong. That snapshot predates the subsequent US AI-hardware selloff and cannot establish today’s HSTECH strength. HKEX filing and suspension lists were checked; no verified material positive offsetting the overnight risk was found.
Commodities
Oil rebounds after a sharp fall but remains a volatility source
Brent rebounded about 2.5% toward $96.8 after the prior day’s sharp decline. A renewed energy-cost rise could revive inflation and rate concerns while weakening the transport-cost relief thesis. Source: Reuters global-markets coverage; the price is the article timestamp, not a live settlement.

US Overnight Summary

Index
Risk assets enter rapid deleveraging
The Nasdaq fell 5.52%, the S&P 500 4.36% and the Dow 3.44%. Runtime QQQ, SPY and DIA proxies remained down 6.33%, 4.35% and 3.50%, with no verifiable after-hours reversal.
Sectors
Advertising stands alone while hardware and chips define the risk
APP +31.04% confirms advertising strength, but Electronic Components, Semiconductors, Equipment, Electrical Parts and Computer Hardware all fell more than 10%. Several representative stocks rose against weak groups, making breadth pressure more important than any single leader.
A/H Map
Defend first in A/H technology; keep solid-state batteries event-specific
The Nov 5 A-share median gain of 1.87% and HSTECH intraday gain of 5.32% both predate the US selloff and cannot be carried forward. Tinci and the solid-state theme remain conditional watches; Raytron and pre-filing limit-up Jingang Solar remain avoids.

Premarket Takeaway

Policy support remains selective: Beijing targets energy storage, smart grids and power chips, while the national conservation plan strengthens computing efficiency, water saving and recycling.

The US selloff broadened across technology, with semiconductor and hardware groups down more than 10%. Prior-day A/H intraday strength is stale, so today starts with a lower risk setting.

Hongsheng Huayuan and Tinci are conditional watches only. Jingang Solar is avoided after a pre-filing limit-up move and uncertain realization; Raytron is avoided on explicit negative price feedback. No bullish card is forced.

Stocks to Watch

Hongsheng Huayuan
601096.SH
Conditional Watch

Fact and status: An after-close filing disclosed about RMB725m of State Grid tender wins, equal to 7.57% of 2025 revenue. The Nov 5 close of RMB3.79 (+0.80%) predates the filing.

Confirmation: Formal contracts are signed and the stock holds above RMB3.79 while outperforming transmission-equipment peers.

Risk / invalidation: Contracts are unsigned and delivery and margins are unknown; a failed gap that breaks below RMB3.79 invalidates the setup.

Tinci Materials
002709.SZ
Conditional Watch

Fact and status: Tinci plans to supply EVE Energy with 450,000 tonnes of electrolyte from 2027 to 2029. The Nov 5 close of RMB29.01 (+5.45%) predates the filing.

Confirmation: The stock holds above RMB29.01, order volume, pricing and production schedules are confirmed, and it remains strong versus battery-material peers.

Risk / invalidation: Actual volume and pricing depend on orders; liquid electrolyte is not direct solid-state exposure. A break below the prior close or clear sector underperformance triggers a downgrade.

Jingang Solar
300093.SZ
Avoid

Fact and status: The cloud-service contract is capped at RMB1.536bn, but the counterparty is not fully disclosed. The stock had already closed at RMB18.66 and hit the 20% limit before the filing.

Reassessment: Customer identity, delivery, collection and profit contribution are repeatedly verified, and the price stabilizes after sufficient post-filing turnover.

Risk / invalidation: The pre-filing move and contract ceiling are not realized revenue; Computer Hardware -14.94% and Electrical Equipment -12.53% add overnight pressure. Do not chase.

Raytron Technology
688002.SH
Avoid

Fact and status: The stock closed Nov 5 at RMB129.40, down 15.42%, aligning with the overnight fall in Semiconductors (-11.46%) and Semiconductor Equipment (-12.33%).

Reassessment: First require stabilization, volume-backed demand and sustained outperformance versus STAR 50 and semiconductor peers.

Risk / invalidation: AI-hardware deleveraging and regulatory concerns remain; negative price feedback must not be reframed as a bullish opportunity. Source: closing quote.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative StrengthAdtech and solid-state batteries; APP confirms the former, while solid-state must be separated from liquid electrolyte
Conditional WatchTransmission tenders and energy/water-efficiency projects; require contracts, pricing and opening relative strength
PressureSemiconductors, equipment, electronic components, electrical parts and computer hardware
ValidationWhether HSTECH and STAR 50 absorb the overnight shock; 601096 holds RMB3.79 and 002709 holds RMB29.01

Logic Chain

US AI-regulation concern + rate-hike signals → Nasdaq and chip rout → higher opening risk premium for A/H technology.
Advertising +18.99% while hardware groups fall more than 10% → rotation from capex beneficiaries toward clearer application cash flow → map only at company level in A/H.
Beijing storage plan + Solid State Battery +8.81% → higher battery attention → Tinci stays conditional because agreement volume and pricing remain order-dependent.
Hongsheng Huayuan tender equals 7.57% of revenue → clear event catalyst but unsigned contract → require both opening-price and contract confirmation.
Jingang Solar limit-up before filing + hardware/electrical rout → poor chase odds → maintain avoid.
